destination: A playable analog video instrument whose behavior can be traced to documented circuitry and repeated through a measurement bench.
next: Pivot to Artifice: inspect its retained GLIC reference and verify a small image-processing path before expanding the interface.
decision: Hardware validation is deferred by the user. Preserve the provisional Phosphlux instrument and all evidence. Further simulator investigation is paused; next development effort moves to Artifice.

phases.title: Preserve the research and choose a tractable circuit
phases.result: Original Phosphlux material retained. Cadet VII v1.1 is the current bounded target; the Paik–Abe channel remains parked.
phases.gate: Revisit source selection when expanding beyond Cadet; missing wiring cannot be filled by guesswork.

phases.title: Build a repeatable bench
phases.result: Deterministic diagnostics plus explicit gain/offset, pulse and five-point small-signal frequency measurements. Sample-level evidence, methods and unestablished results remain visible.
phases.gate: Timing fault detection and a general calibration acceptance policy are still open; a working runner is not the whole bench contract.

phases.title: Qualify the component and coupled models
phases.result: Full model remains unqualified. Research and diagnostics are preserved; further solver patches and failure instrumentation are paused by agreement.
phases.gate: Locate the sensitivity, justify usable numerical limits and qualify the model under the intended rails and loads.

phases.title: Validate one complete Cadet module
phases.result: A playable partial dynamic signal path now passes 24 named reference cases. The full power/reference circuit remains unqualified. Physical-board measurements: zero.
phases.gate: Reopen when an identified board and suitable measurement equipment or sufficiently documented independent reference are available.

phases.title: Turn the validated model into a playable module
phases.result: Source selection, play/pause/step/restart, local saved patches, patch import/export, PNG snapshots and voltage CSV export. Existing diagnostic and measurement views remain.
phases.gate: Hardware fidelity is not established. This bounded usability slice is complete; broader instrument development pivots to Artifice.

phases.title: Expand the selected instrument
phases.result: Add documented channels and processing only after the first module has a credible reference. Cadet progress does not settle the Paik–Abe design.
phases.gate: Select each new circuit boundary, then verify mixing, isolation and interactions before adding it to the instrument.

phases.title: Add evidenced display and feedback behavior
phases.result: CRT, phosphor, deflection and feedback remain part of the wider aspiration, with no implementation claim here.
phases.gate: Choose the hardware scope and validate the electrical and optical paths separately. No decorative effect counts as analog emulation.
